scope_statement: Curated landmark posterolateral studies with appraisal notes.
source_note: No sources were retrieved. The generation environment had no access to PubMed, Cochrane, any journal or any textbook. The Tier 1 source minimum is NOT met and this draft would not pass Tier 1 in the deployed pipeline. This is the first section on the site written entirely for professionals, and it is unverified.
claims_needing_verification: Whether to add a lateral procedure is the least settled balance in this chapter.
Rotational contribution argues for it and disputed anatomy with unknown long term constraint effects argues against.
The five patient factors, and rotational demand in particular, do most of the deciding.
Record the balance, because the evidence is moving and the record is what makes a decision reviewable.
Practice moved ahead of anatomy here, which is a pattern to recognise rather than condemn.
claims_note: Listed above are the substantive claims, taken from the deepest tier's key learning points. Every anatomical statement in the page body requires the same verification against a standard text; these are the ones a reviewer should start with.
content_rule: Decision 022: this page's subject is named studies and no study was retrieved. The page names the author a study is taught under and the decade it belongs to, and gives no year, journal, volume or page, because those are the parts of a citation that get invented and a wrong one cannot be told from a right one. ATTR-001 refuses any of them at the gate. Every attribution is registered in pipeline/config/attributions/<page_id>.json with the claim it carries and a verification state. Run tools/attributions.py --report --unchecked for the outstanding list. Decision 006 applies as usual to any measurement on the page.
gaps_or_uncertainties: 4 attribution(s) on this page, each naming an author a study is taught under. All are written from memory and none has been checked against the paper. They are listed in pipeline/config/attributions/3.17.5.json with the claim each one carries. Some will be wrong, and which ones is not knowable from here.

No landmark papers page on this site carries a citation, a year, a journal or a page number, and that is decision 022 rather than an omission. A reader who wants the paper has a surname, a decade and a finding, which locates it in a catalogue and does not constitute a citation.
No measurement appears on this page. Where one would normally sit the page gives the relationship instead, because the value is not one this environment can state with confidence.
